content: {"like":["Values high-quality audiovisual experience (clear images, good sound, no interruptions), prefers detailed storytelling and well-written scripts, appreciates strong performances and talented actors, enjoys well-crafted costumes and happy endings, seeks content that aligns closely with scriptural or historical accuracy."],"dislike":["Dislikes any form of interruption or filler content (credits, previews, breaks), avoids editions with excessive extras (Keepsake Edition), rejects low-quality audio/visual formats (DVD with skipping), is critical of subpar science fiction, and will not rewatch content that fails to meet personal standards."]}
